title: Pro-Cap: Leveraging a Frozen Vision-Language Model for Hateful Meme Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating hateful meme detection performance (AUC and Accuracy) on the FHM dataset by probing vision-language models to extract the race of individuals in the images and using it to predict racially hateful content.

Evaluating hateful meme and misogyny detection performance on the FHM and MAMI datasets by probing vision-language models to extract the gender of individuals in the images to detect misogynistic and gender-targeted hate.

Evaluating hateful meme detection performance on the FHM dataset by probing vision-language models to extract the inferred religion of individuals in the images (and related proxies like specific animals) to identify religiously hateful content.

Evaluating hateful meme detection performance on the FHM dataset by probing vision-language models to extract the nationality or country of origin of individuals in the images to predict nationality-targeted hate.

Evaluating hateful meme detection performance on the FHM dataset by probing vision-language models for the presence of disabled individuals in the images to identify disability-targeted hateful memes.
